color.note: Bento Launchpad: deep navy neutrals with three light sources (orange brand, cyan data, indigo AI). Dark is primary for product, marketing and docs; light is a full equal for docs and daytime use. Orange marks what you act on; cyan marks data and live runs; indigo marks AI.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground for landing, docs and the IDE canvas. The aurora glows sit on it.

tokens.name: canvas-grid
tokens.usage: IDE canvas dot grid and the faint section grid on landing pages. Decorative.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App shell: IDE top bar, docs top nav, footer.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Docked panels: library, inspector, docs sidebar, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Bento cards, nodes, step cards, menus, toasts, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Inputs, hover rows, segmented tracks, inline code chips, table headers.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the command bar.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and tables.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card, node, panel and input outlines at rest (the bento hairline).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input hover, edges between nodes, pending ring. 3:1 on surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines, node titles, body copy on every surface and on canvas.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Leads, descriptions in bento cards, field labels, docs prose secondary text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, timestamps, footnotes, taskReferenceName. 4.5:1 on canvas to surface-3.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only (exempt from contrast); pair with a reason.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: CMASTER orange. Primary buttons, the selection ring, the active tab and mode, the run action, eyebrow labels, the logo. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-400
tokens.usage: Hover of brand-500 fills.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Pressed brand-500 fills.

tokens.name: brand-300
tokens.usage: End stop of the hero keyword gradient (text-primary to brand-300) in dark theme; soft highlights. Never body text in light theme.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text or a 1px line: eyebrows, links, active tab labels, std tags. On canvas to surface-3.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active chips, drop targets, primary-button halo.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-500/400/600 fills (6.7:1).

tokens.name: data
tokens.usage: Data: ${...} references, data pills, lineage edges, JSON keys, the running state, the second aurora light.

tokens.name: data-tint
tokens.usage: Data pill and lineage highlight background.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: AI: Sparkles icon, AI chips, the copilot cursor, the third aurora light. Small marks only.

tokens.name: ai-tint
tokens.usage: AI message bubbles and AI suggestion rows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring, 2px offset, on every control.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Running ring and badge; always with a spinner and the word 运行中.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Completed; always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed or terminated; always with an x icon and a word. Form errors.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on status-failed fills.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Timed out, paused, warnings, version update available.

tokens.name: status-skipped
tokens.usage: Skipped nodes (dashed outline).

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: Scheduled, not started.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success badges, tip callouts.

tokens.name: failed-tint
tokens.usage: Failure badges, danger callouts, failed node glow.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning badges and callouts.

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Shadow Graph: proposed addition.

tokens.name: diff-modified
tokens.usage: Shadow Graph: proposed change.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Shadow Graph: proposed removal (dashed, 50% opacity).

tokens.name: cat-control

tokens.usage: Node category tile: INLINE, JSON_JQ, SET_VARIABLE (数据处理).
